meta.title: Incident Response Memory Palace
meta.subtitle: Learning Navigation · Memory Palace
meta.briefing: Walk the incident response palace. Each room contains memory anchors for a phase of response; collect the right anchors, avoid confusion traps, and unlock the next chamber.

sourceElement.label: Response Archivist
sourceElement.description: The palace is organized by response phase. Pick up each anchor only when it supports the phase you are standing in.

sourceElement.label: Detect: Confirm the signal
sourceElement.description: A useful incident starts with a validated alert, scoped time window, and affected system.
sourceElement.evidence: Validate the alert before escalating: identify the affected system, signal source, and time range.

sourceElement.label: Triage: Establish severity
sourceElement.description: Severity depends on blast radius, business impact, active exploitation, and data sensitivity.
sourceElement.evidence: Set severity from impact, scope, exploit activity, and sensitive data exposure.

sourceElement.label: Confusion Trap: Assume benign
sourceElement.description: Dismissing a repeated alert without evidence can hide a real compromise.
sourceElement.evidence: Repeated alerts need evidence-backed closure, not assumptions.

sourceElement.label: Contain: Isolate safely
sourceElement.description: Containment should stop spread while preserving evidence and critical service dependencies.
sourceElement.evidence: Isolate the affected host or credential path without destroying forensic evidence.

sourceElement.label: Eradicate: Remove persistence
sourceElement.description: Remove malicious accounts, scheduled tasks, startup entries, and compromised secrets.
sourceElement.evidence: Persistence mechanisms must be removed before recovery begins.

sourceElement.label: Confusion Trap: Wipe first
sourceElement.description: Reimaging before evidence capture can erase the root cause and attacker path.
sourceElement.evidence: Capture the evidence needed for root cause before destructive recovery steps.

sourceElement.label: Recover: Validate clean service
sourceElement.description: Recovery is complete only after patched systems are monitored and normal behavior is confirmed.
sourceElement.evidence: Validate recovery with monitoring, service checks, and signs that attacker access is gone.
